approval_id.description: The approval request it waits for.

checks.description: Before release: what stops it being asked for, approved or released (✖), every problem at once. Empty in a list.

method.description: How the bank pays it: FAST, within minutes, or GIRO, over the next working days.

money_account_id.description: The SGD bank account it is paid from: the chart's money account, as a payment recorded by hand names it.

examples: End of October suppliers and claims

number.description: Its number, from the batch sequence, once approved (FR-ORG-04).

payment_date.description: The day the bank pays it: each payment is posted on it.

payments.description: One payment per payee: a supplier's bills as one bill payment, a claimant's claims as one reimbursement.

prepared_by.description: Who saved its current version: an actor of the audit trail.

release.description: A released batch: who released it, when, under which approval, its file's name and hash, and the payments it posted.

status.description: draft: being prepared; waiting: asked for, waiting for approval; approved: ready to release; released: its payments posted and its payment list written; cancelled: before release, with a reason.

total.description: What it pays in all, in SGD.

version.description: The batch's version; with its status it makes the ETag.
